title: Constant outer terms: a trivialising cover for the middle term
statement: Let X be a scheme, Λ a finite (not necessarily commutative) ring, and 0 → F₁ → E → F₃ → 0 a short exact sequence of sheaves of left Λ-modules on the small étale site of X [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Assume F₁ and F₃ are constant [def-constructible-constant] and have finitely generated geometric stalks [def-constructible-finite]. There exists an étale cover (Uᵢ → X) such that the inverse image of E on every Uᵢ is a constant sheaf.

source.place: Tag 03RX (3), lemma-kernel-finite-locally-constant; via Modules on Sites Tag 093U

proof.text: Apply the local cokernel presentation theorem to obtain a cover on which the middle term is a cokernel of a map between constant sheaves.

For each map from a finitely generated constant sheaf to a constant sheaf, use the constant-morphism local lemma and the constant cokernel isomorphism to refine the cover so the cokernel is constant. Bind the covers.
